build_your_way.title: Build Your Way
build_your_way.description: The AI Dev Workspace product family supports every way of building, so individuals and teams can find the tools that fit their workflow.

modules.title: Pulse Dev Process Watchdog
modules.subtitle: Autonomous Port Collision Management & Live Server Telemetry
modules.description: Manage and orchestrate all local development servers with zero terminal friction. Pulse continuously monitors port occupancy, terminates orphaned processes, and boots your Vite, Next.js, and Node servers on demand with live health metrics.
points: Auto Port Collision Detection: Identifies if port :5173, :3000, or :8080 is blocked and frees it instantly.
Real-time Telemetry: Instant visibility into memory consumption, CPU load, and server uptime.
Hot Reload Watchdog: Automatically detects fallen child processes and restarts them silently.

modules.title: Multi-Agent Roundtable Studio
modules.subtitle: 7 Interactive 3D Avatars Collaborating for Flawless Architecture
modules.description: Assemble a council of specialized AI engineers directly inside your desktop workspace. The Lead Architect, Security Auditor, Frontend Engineer, and QA Testers collaborate in real-time with 3D miniature avatars to review code and plan features before implementation.
points: Summon AI Council: Trigger multi-perspective debates across specialized personas for any complex problem.
Consensus Code Verification: Personas scrutinize security flaws, performance regressions, and clean architecture.
3D Miniature Feedback: Visual status cues indicate speaking, researching, compiling, and testing states.

modules.title: 1-Click Autonomous Error Diagnostic
modules.subtitle: Deep AST Log Parsing, Root Cause Explanation & Self-Healing Patches
modules.description: Eliminate debugging fatigue. When terminal crashes, webpack bundle errors, or React runtime exceptions occur, AI Dev Workspace analyzes the stack trace, extracts the AST node, and provides a 1-click self-healing patch directly to disk.
points: Live Terminal Interception: Automatically intercepts build errors, missing dependencies, and syntax failures.
AST Root Cause Breakdown: Explains the exact failure point in clear terms with highlighted diffs.
1-Click Auto Patch: Applies atomic file fixes to your repository with automated rollback safeguards.

modules.badge: Local Drive Indexer • Zero Cloud Upload
modules.title: Autonomous Drive AutoScan
modules.subtitle: Recursive Project Discovery across C:, D:, and E: Drives
modules.description: Instant visibility over all your codebases without tedious directory browsing. The sovereign drive scanner walks your storage drives in milliseconds, discovering Git repositories, package.json definitions, and framework configurations.
points: 1-Click Drive Sweep: Scans root drives C:, D:, and E: with zero network transmissions.
Framework Recognition: Detects Vite, Next.js, React, Electron, Python, and Rust setups.
Instant Switcher: Switch between hundreds of local repositories in under 100 milliseconds.

modules.badge: Native Bridge • VS Code, Figma & Chrome
modules.title: PC Apps & Environment Bridge
modules.subtitle: Unified Control Hub for Installed Development Applications
modules.description: Bridge your desktop IDEs, browsers, design tools, and terminal sessions into a single orchestrator. Launch VS Code with project context, mirror UI in Google Chrome, sync designs with Figma, and orchestrate Git workflows effortlessly.
points: App Auto-Discovery: Automatically detects installed editors, browsers, and terminal emulators.
Deep Project Launch: Launches target workspaces straight into VS Code, Cursor, or WebStorm.
Integrated Dev Flow: Jump from Figma design specs directly into code generation and browser viewports.

downloads.title: Download AI Dev Workspace for Windows
downloads.subtitle: Choose between the full Windows Installer Wizard or the zero-install Portable executable. Both binaries are cryptographically signed and SHA-256 verified.
